drawings.description: en haut à gauche du feuillet : un cercle portant quatre sommets marqués, de chacun desquels part vers l'extérieur un faisceau de trois traits ou plus (celui de droite très chargé) ; autour, quatre flèches courbes indiquant un sens de rotation.
drawings.kind: circle with four marked vertices, bundles of rays and rotation arrows
drawings.notes: The circle, four marked vertices on it (top, left, right, bottom), and from each a bundle of strokes going outwards, all drawn from the vertex: three at the top, two at the left, six at the right (three heavy ones close together to the upper right, three thinner ones to the right and lower right), three at the bottom. Round the figure four curved arrows: above (pointing left), at the left (pointing down), at the right (pointing up), below (pointing right). Still differs: the heavy bundle at the right is a blot of several strokes, drawn as three; the arrows above and below turn the same way round the circle as drawn here only if read as on the page (not checked against a meaning). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: moitié gauche du feuillet, grande figure au crayon : un grand disque dont le bord, repassé d'un trait épais en haut et à droite, porte une quinzaine de petits traits, et qui est découpé par huit cordes courbes qui ne se rencontrent pas ; à l'intérieur, deux gros points d'où part un trait (les sommets de l'arbre dual), l'un près de deux traits croisés et d'un petit cercle pâle, et un second cercle pâle plus grand, en bas ; à gauche, hors du disque, des arcs portant des marques et deux petites bosses, et un second arc épais.
drawings.kind: large disc cut by non-crossing chords, with marked boundary points and vertices of a dual tree
drawings.notes: The heavy rim from the upper left over the top to the lower right, with its marks; the faint left part of the outline and the faint closing arc at the bottom (pencil). Eight chords, ends on the rim: a small bump and an arch at the top left; the long chord from the upper left down and across to the lower right; three nested chords from the top to the right side; a bump at the upper right and a tiny one beside the marked point of the top right. Inside: a heavy point with a stroke to the right, beside two crossing strokes and a faint small circle; a second heavy point at the lower right with two strokes; the faint circle at the bottom with three marks. At the left, outside: the second heavy arc with its small bump and a side stroke, the faint arc with marks and a bump, a short curve at the bottom left, and the sign made of two short strokes with « 1 0 » under them (drawn as strokes, not read). Still differs: a whole-page pencil figure read off a wide crop (1 to 3 units); the number of rim marks, the faint strokes (several are doubled or erased) and the attachment of the chord ends are approximate; the note of the transcription speaks of « l'arbre dual tracé à l'intérieur »: only two vertices with one or two strokes each are visible, not a whole tree. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: moitié droite du feuillet, cinq disques au crayon, chacun avec des points ou de petits traits marqués sur son bord et des cordes courbes à l'intérieur : deux disques pâles en haut (le second, plus grand, posé sur un trait horizontal portant un point) ; au milieu deux disques plus petits au bord repassé, portant chacun huit à neuf marques et trois cordes ; au-dessous deux courts segments ; en bas un disque plus grand, au bord repassé en haut à droite, découpé par une longue corde et quatre plus petites.
drawings.kind: five discs with marked boundary points and non-crossing chords
drawings.notes: Five discs, each an ellipse fitted to his outline, with the marks and points of its rim placed on the outline and its chords ending on it. Top left (faint): one heavy chord cutting off a cap at the top, three marks and a point. Top right (faint, larger): a small chord and a long faint one, four points on the rim; under it a horizontal stroke with a point in its middle. Middle left: eight marks and a point, three chords (a cap at the top, a long one across, a small one at the right). Middle right: eight marks, a heavy sliver at the upper left, a small chord at the right, a faint chord across; under it an oblique stroke. Then two short segments with end marks. Bottom: about fourteen marks and two points, a long chord from the top to the lower right, a bump at the top, a bump at the right, and two faint chords at the lower left. Left out: a pencil squiggle between the segments and the bottom disc, faint erased strokes at its right, and the strokes hanging under the middle left disc. Still differs: read off a wide crop (1 to 3 units); the counts of rim marks are approximate, heavy marks are not distinguished from light ones, and faint chords may be erased ones. The note of the transcription describes this half as « deux disques reliés par une arête, le second plus petit et rayonnant »: that pair is at the bottom of the sheet (drawing 01-5); the five discs here are not mentioned. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au bas du feuillet, à gauche : un disque dont le bord, épaissi par endroits, porte une vingtaine de petits traits et de points marqués, et à l'intérieur duquel sont tracées huit cordes courbes qui ne se rencontrent pas : une longue corde du haut vers le bas, deux cordes emboîtées en haut à droite, une longue corde à droite, une corde à gauche, une petite à droite, deux petites en bas.
drawings.kind: disc with marked boundary points and non-crossing chords
drawings.notes: The disc (an ellipse fitted to his outline), about twenty marks on the rim (short radial ticks, heavier at the left, at the upper right and at the right, where he went over them), and eight curved chords inside, none crossing another, each ending on the rim (ends computed on the outline): (1) at the left, from the upper left to the left; (2) the long one from the top down to the lower right of the bottom; (3) and (4) two nested arches at the upper right, starting beside the top of (2) and ending at the two marks of the upper right; (5) a long one from the outer end of (4) down the right side to the lower right; (6) a small bump on the right rim; (7) a low arch at the bottom left; (8) a small arch at the bottom. Disagreement with the note of the transcription, which says « trois cordes »: eight are counted. Still differs: the exact number of marks on the rim (some are doubled or blotted), and which mark each chord end meets: the ends are put on the rim where the strokes arrive, without being snapped to a mark. Whether (4) and (5) share their end at the upper right, as drawn, is a reading. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The note says « trois cordes »; eight chords are drawn inside the disc.

drawings.description: bas du feuillet, trois figures au crayon : à gauche un arc épais portant trois points marqués, d'où partent vers l'intérieur un trait, une bosse et un second trait ; au milieu un grand cercle pâle, avec en bas une petite bosse et quelques points marqués ; à droite un petit cercle d'où rayonnent quatre traits, relié vers la gauche par l'un d'eux.
drawings.kind: arc with chords, a large faint circle, a small radiating circle
drawings.notes: Left: the heavy arc with three marked points on it, a stroke going down from it at the left, a bump (a small chord) in the middle and a second stroke going down at the right. Middle: the large faint circle (an ellipse fitted to it), with a small bump and five marked points at its bottom. Right: the small circle with three marks on it and four strokes radiating from it (two up, one to the lower right, one long to the lower left, towards the large circle, which it does not reach). Still differs: positions read off a wide crop; the large circle is drawn once (he went round it twice). This is the pair « deux disques reliés par une arête, le second plus petit et rayonnant » of the note of the transcription, if the long stroke of the small circle is taken as the edge. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut, au milieu : une ligne horizontale portant cinq sommets $s_0$, $s_1$, $s_2$, $s_3$, $s_4$, fléchée entre eux ; sur chaque sommet, un bouquet de boucles en pétales (une sur $s_0$, trois sur $s_1$, deux sur $s_2$, trois sur $s_3$, trois sur $s_4$), chacune marquée « $w$ » ; « $w$ » encore sous les arêtes $s_1 s_2$ et $s_2 s_3$. Au-dessous de $s_0$, une petite figure : une boucle sur un sommet relié par une arête à un second sommet.
drawings.kind: chain of five vertices with bouquets of loops marked w
drawings.notes: The line through the five vertices (points), with arrowheads as on the page: from s_0 to s_1, from s_2 to s_1, from s_3 to s_2, from s_3 to s_4; on each vertex its loops, drawn as petals from the vertex (1, 3, 2, 3, 3), a letter w above each petal and under the two middle edges; the labels s_0 to s_4 under the vertices. Below s_0 the small figure: a loop on a vertex, and an edge from it to a second vertex. Still differs: the petals are regularised (same width, tips where he drew them); the count of loops on s_1 (three, two of them overlapping) and on s_4 (at the edge of the group, three) is a reading; a stray point under the small figure is left out. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut à droite du feuillet, quatre cercles : un cercle dont partent sept rayons depuis le centre, avec trois arcs du bord épaissis ; un petit cercle d'où rayonnent huit traits ; un disque hachuré portant cinq sommets marqués, de quatre desquels part un faisceau de deux ou trois traits ; plus bas, un cercle plus grand avec trois départs de traits, dont un double en haut à droite.
drawings.kind: four circles with radii, marked vertices and bundles of rays
drawings.notes: Four figures. (1) Left: a circle with seven radii from its centre to the rim (all drawn from the centre) and three heavy arcs on the rim (upper left, right, bottom). (2) Top right: a small circle with eight short strokes radiating from it and a double tick at its top. (3) Below it: a disc hatched with oblique strokes, five heavy vertices on its rim (top, upper right, left, bottom, lower right); bundles of strokes leave four of them: three from the upper right, three from the left, three from the bottom, two from the lower right; a double tick beside the lower right one. (4) Bottom: a larger circle with two strokes meeting at one point of its rim at the upper right, one long stroke to the left and one stroke downwards from its foot. Left out: the long faint pencil lines that cross figure (1) and run over the sheet, the pencil star with two blackened wedges at its left, and everything else on the sheet (see the notes of the report: the other figures of this trial sheet are not redrawn). Still differs: positions read off a wide crop; the radii of (1) are not all of the same hand (some are the long pencil lines passing through the centre). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au milieu de la moitié gauche, au crayon : un arbre de flèches. Une tige fléchée descend jusqu'à un sommet, d'où partent une flèche vers le haut à droite, une branche fléchée vers le bas à gauche et une branche horizontale repassée d'un trait épais, portant trois pointes de flèche ; du bout de celle-ci, une branche fléchée monte à droite jusqu'à un second sommet et se prolonge vers $s_3$, une autre descend à droite ; du second sommet part vers la droite un trait qui se divise en deux.
drawings.notes: The stem coming down to the first vertex with three arrowheads on it, the short arrow to the upper right, the branch to the lower left with two arrowheads, the heavy horizontal branch with three heavy arrowheads (drawn with a double stroke on the page, here one thick line), the branch rising to the second vertex with two arrowheads and its continuation up to the chain of 01-6 (it ends under s_3), the branch going down to the right with a small tick across it, and the faint stroke leaving the second vertex to the right and forking in two. Every branch is drawn from the computed vertex. Overlaid on the 400 dpi crop: the strokes fall on the page's. Not drawn: the ink frame of the list at the right, which the fork runs over. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, sous le cercle aux faisceaux, au crayon : deux arbres de petites flèches mises bout à bout (le premier monte d'un point marqué par quatre flèches, avec trois flèches latérales vers la droite ; le second, issu de la première flèche latérale, monte par trois flèches avec deux départs latéraux, et une flèche lui arrive par-dessous d'un second point marqué) ; à leur droite, deux points marqués joints par deux traits fins et par deux chaînes de trois et quatre flèches, l'une au-dessus, l'autre au-dessous.
drawings.kind: pencil trees of small arrows; two points joined by two chains of arrows
drawings.notes: First tree: the marked point at the bottom left, four arrows end to end going up from it, three side arrows to the right (the top one curved, the bottom one leaving the marked point) and a faint curve beside the second arrow. Second tree: it starts where the bottom side arrow ends; three arrows going up, a side arrow to the right, a faint stroke to the upper right from the second node; under it an arrow coming up from a second marked point, with a faint curve beside it. Right: two marked points joined by two thin straight lines and by two chains of arrows, three above and four below. 21 arrows in all, each drawn with its gap as on the page (the arrows do not touch). Overlaid on the 400 dpi crop. The second marked point is also the top of the three-branched tree of 01-10. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au-dessous, au crayon : un arbre à trois branches (un trait épais descend d'un point marqué à un gros sommet, d'où partent deux branches vers le bas, celle de gauche épaisse et terminée par un gros point) ; à droite, une flèche montante d'où part un trait ; un « W » de quatre flèches issues de deux pointes basses ; un losange de quatre flèches ; un trait et une boucle en épingle fléchée.
drawings.kind: three-branched tree, W of arrows, lozenge of arrows, hairpin loop
drawings.notes: Left: the tree with three branches: marked point at the top (it is the lower marked point of 01-9), heavy stroke down to the heavy vertex, a heavy branch to the lower left ending in a heavy point, a thinner branch to the lower right with a point just beyond its end; two faint straight strokes beside it and an isolated point at the right. Then an arrow going up with a stroke leaving its head to the upper right; a W of arrows (two arrows going up from the lower left tip, one short arrow between them, one arrow going up from the lower right tip, a short stroke closing the tip); a lozenge of four arrows (two lower ones going up and outwards, two upper ones going up and inwards); a stroke coming down to a hairpin loop with an arrowhead on its right arm and a short stroke inside it, and a faint curve arriving from the left. Overlaid on the 400 dpi crop. Not drawn: the ink letter I above the W (text). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: devant les quatre premières lignes écrites, à l'encre, quatre petits cercles, un par ligne : devant « identité », un cercle nu surmonté d'une flèche courbe ; devant « lettre $u$ … », un cercle portant deux points marqués, en haut et en bas, surmonté d'une flèche courbe ; devant « système de deux lettres », un cercle à deux points marqués, « $u$ » à gauche, « $v$ » à droite, « $\sigma$ » dessous, surmonté d'une flèche courbe ; devant « système de trois lettres », un cercle à trois points marqués. Au-dessous, trois cercles raturés.
drawings.kind: four small circles with marked points (legend of the list)
drawings.notes: The four ink circles standing before the four written lines, each a circle fitted to his: (1) bare, with a curved arrow above it pointing left; (2) two marked points, top and bottom, the same arrow; (3) two marked points, top and bottom, u at the left, v at the right, sigma below, the same arrow; (4) three marked points (upper left, upper right, bottom). Overlaid on the 400 dpi crop. Still differs: on circle (4) the two upper marks are small wedges that look like arrowheads along the circle; their direction cannot be read and they are drawn as points. Not drawn: the frame round the first two lines, the words, and the three circles below, which are scribbled over (a pencil one at the left, two ink ones at the right, the upper with a diameter and a curved arrow, the lower with a chord and three marked points): struck. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au-dessous des cercles raturés, dans un cadre ouvert à gauche et marqué « 2 » : un cercle partagé par un diamètre horizontal, avec deux points marqués, en haut (« $\tau$ ») et en bas (« $\sigma$ »), « $u^{-1}$ » à gauche et « $u$ » à droite ; sous le cadre, « $u+w$ » et une flèche à deux pointes portant un point en son milieu.
drawings.kind: circle cut by a diameter with labels, in a frame; double arrow
drawings.notes: The frame (top side, right side, bottom side; open at the left), the circle (an ellipse fitted to his) with its horizontal diameter, the two marked points at the top and at the bottom, tau beside the top one, sigma under the bottom one, u^{-1} at the left of the diameter (written heavily, over something), u at its right, the figure 2 at the right of the frame; below, u+w and the double-headed arrow with a point at its middle. Overlaid on the 400 dpi crop. Reading: the small letter beside the top point is taken as tau (it could be an r). Not drawn: the struck u+v written before u+w (struck on the page), and the faint pencil strokes that run over the top of the frame. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut, entre la chaîne $s_0 \dots s_4$ et les cercles de droite, au crayon : un cercle pâle portant cinq marques épaisses, deux secteurs noircis issus de son centre, à gauche et à droite, prolongés de traits épais, et quatre longs traits fins passant par le centre.
drawings.kind: faint circle with five rim marks, two blackened wedges, lines through the centre
drawings.notes: The faint circle (an ellipse fitted to his), five heavy marks on it (top, left, right, lower right, lower left), the two blackened wedges with their apex at the centre, one to the left and one to the upper right, each continued by heavy strokes beyond the circle (two at the left, three at the right), and four thin lines ending at or passing through the centre (from the upper left, from the top to the bottom, from the lower left, to the lower right), all drawn through one computed centre. Overlaid on the 400 dpi crop. Still differs: the wedges are scribbled black on the page and their outline is not sharp; they are drawn as filled triangles. Not drawn: the ink line of the list's frame passing under the figure. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au milieu de la moitié droite, au crayon : un grand cercle pâle, repassé en bas, portant quatre points marqués, deux pleins (en haut et en bas) et deux cerclés (à gauche et à droite) ; à côté du point cerclé de droite, « sommets principaux » ; en haut à droite, deux traits quittent le cercle.
drawings.kind: large circle with four marked points, two of them ringed
drawings.notes: The circle, its lower rim doubled by a second arc, four marked points on it placed on the computed circle: full at the top and at the bottom, ringed (a point inside a heavy ring) at the left and at the right; the words « sommets principaux » beside the ringed point at the right; at the upper right a stroke leaving the circle upwards (with two short strokes beside it) and another to the right; the end of a long stroke arriving at the lower left. Overlaid on the 400 dpi crop. The transcription's note says the words designate two of the marked points: on the page the two ringed points are the ones set apart. Not drawn: the ink writing that runs over the left of the circle. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au-dessous, au crayon : un cercle pâle portant quatre sommets marqués ; de trois d'entre eux part vers l'extérieur un faisceau de trois ou quatre traits ; l'arc entre les sommets de gauche est repassé et fléché.
drawings.kind: circle with four marked vertices and three bundles of rays
drawings.notes: The faint circle through the four marked vertices (upper left, left, bottom, upper right); the arcs from the upper left vertex to the left one and from the left one to the bottom one are gone over, with an arrowhead pointing down on the first and a small tick on the second; two small points beside the bottom vertex; small arrowheads on the circle on each side of the upper right vertex. Rays, all drawn from their vertex: three from the upper left one, four from the upper right one (one heavy, one curved), three from the bottom one (one heavy). Overlaid on the 400 dpi crop. Still differs: a wavy scribble runs along the heavy ray of the bottom vertex and is not drawn; the curved ray of the upper right vertex leads to a short underlined pencil word that could not be read, and a second illegible pencil word stands at the right of the circle: both left out. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au bas du feuillet, au crayon, trois figures : à gauche, un éventail de traits issus d'un point, avec un petit secteur de cercle partagé par trois rayons ; au milieu, deux traits croisés au centre d'un cercle pâle, avec un coin noirci posé sur une barre épaisse ; au-dessous, deux traits croisés et une boucle en épingle.
drawings.kind: fan of strokes with a small sector; crossed lines with a blackened wedge; crossed lines with a hairpin loop
drawings.notes: Left: seven strokes from one computed point (a curve from the upper left, a stroke to the upper right, a bundle of two to the left, two to the lower left, one to the lower right) and a small sector of circle below the point, cut by three radii, with two points on its arc. Middle: two lines crossing at the centre of a faint circle, a narrow blackened wedge under the crossing standing on a heavy bar, a point at the lower left. Below: two lines crossing, a faint curve at the left of the crossing and a hairpin loop hanging from it with a short heavy stroke inside. Overlaid on the 400 dpi crop. Still differs: the bundle at the left of the fan is three or four strokes on the page (two drawn); the faint circle of the middle figure is hardly visible and its radius is approximate. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: près du bord droit : au bout des deux lignes du premier cadre, deux petits cercles à l'encre, chacun surmonté d'une flèche courbe (le premier avec un point marqué en bas, le second partagé par un diamètre, avec un point marqué en haut et un en bas) ; sous le second cadre, au crayon, un grand cercle pâle portant une marque en bas à gauche.
drawings.kind: two small marked circles, a large faint circle
drawings.notes: The two small ink circles (ellipses fitted to his), each with a curved arrow above it pointing left: the first with one marked point at the bottom, the second cut by a horizontal diameter with marked points at the top and at the bottom. Below, the large faint pencil circle with a short heavy tick on its rim at the lower left. Overlaid on the 400 dpi crop. Not drawn: the two frames and their words. Disagreement with the transcription's note (« chacun des deux cadres est suivi d'un petit cercle marqué »): both small circles stand inside the first frame, one at the end of each of its two lines. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
